title: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md: four sentences contradict the fork contract's code (CI scope, path classes, ## Head)
claim: Four units of docs/CONTRIBUTING.md are false against the code that decides them: a fork pull request's CI run skips lanes, three path classes differ from the table, and `## Head` cannot be `n/a: <reason>`.
mechanism: The page summarises tools/ci/prelude.py, tools/pr/outside.py and policy_lint.mjs's checkPrBody in prose that no check reads. (1) 'CI runs every lane on every push from a fork; nothing is skipped': prelude.outputs gives every pull_request run scope=auto, stands the four LANE_GATE machinery lanes down on a product-only diff, and codeql_scope.decide skips a leg when no custom_components/ or .github/ path changed; only a push runs full (21 switches off over three fork arms, 0 on the push null). (2) The 'What you may change' table: Rules.free admits the pull request's own dev/programme/delivery/<N>.md (table says refused), Rules.classify gives four CODEOWNERS-owned dev/audit/ paths class O (table says refused), and tests/README.md is in POLICY_GLOBS so class R (table says owner-read). (3) 'Each is content or n/a: <reason>': checkPrBody refuses `## Head` as n/a (rc 1) because it must name the head commit.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; the number is a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb fork-full: prelude.py's line `"scope": "full" if ev == "push" else "auto",` edited in memory to `"scope": "full",`, prelude.machinery forced True and codeql_scope.decide forced to analyze (the CI sentence made true)
perturbation.observed_value: false_rows 4 -> 3; ci_skipped_switches 21 -> 0. Second arm: --perturb delivery-row-refused moves class_mismatch_delivery 1788 -> 0 and class_mismatch_paths 3 -> 2; --perturb machinery-true moves ci_skipped_switches 21 -> 9

metric_definition: Units of docs/CONTRIBUTING.md (text_ledger.py D6 units) whose executed check against the deciding production symbol contradicts the sentence.
phenomenon_property: Every claim docs/CONTRIBUTING.md makes about the fork contract (CI coverage, path classes, body headings, review words, adoption) agrees with tools/ci/prelude.py, tools/pr/outside.py, policy_lint.mjs --pr-body and bus.sh adopt at the same tree.

null_control.command: same harness, its push arm (prelude.outputs for event push)
null_control.note: a push to main runs every lane, so the skip count vanishes where the code intends full runs

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s7/contributing.py --repo <git dir holding 92d38ecb> ; read RESULT false_rows and the per-arm RESULT lines
awk -F'\t' '$6=="false"' dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s7/ledger_contributing.tsv lists the four rows with their truth
proposed_fix_scope: Rewrite the four sentences in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md to the code: a fork run is scoped like any pull request (only a push to main runs full); the table adds the PR's own delivery row (free), the CODEOWNERS-owned paths outside tests/ and docs/ (owner-read) and the policy set (refused, tests/README.md included); `## Head` names the head commit. Optionally register the page's claims in tests/doc_claims.py so a drift fails the gate.
